part1_generic_jacobian_rank.summary: For r=20..24 and primes 65521, 104729, 1000003: generic Jacobian rank = min(25r, 729) consistently. σ_r has the expected dimension (no deficiency for any r ≤ 24).

part2_cn122_truncation.summary: For ALL 23 term-drops from cn122 and serendipitous over F_65521 and F_104729: residual NOT in Jacobian image. No first-order shortening exists from any known rank-23 scheme.

part3_at_solutions.summary: At 5 random rank-22 solution points over F_65521: Jacobian rank = 550 consistently, fiber_dim = 44.

part4_shortened_system.summary: After W-elimination: 531 equations in 396 UV variables, effectively 352 independent (= 550 - 198). Expected moduli dimension = 44 - gauge. Gauge (GL3^3 + rescaling) = 49 > 44 => generically discrete decompositions.

scientific_interpretation.consequence: Any rank-22 decomposition of T333 must be isolated modulo symmetry and fundamentally different from perturbations of known rank-23 schemes. The pairing-defect locus in the rank-23 fiber has expected codimension 59, which in the 90-dimensional fiber gives expected dimension 31; since the gauge orbit has dimension ~70 > 31, the pairing-defect moduli is expected negative-dimensional, suggesting emptiness.
